sources.title: opt-350m: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview opt-350m is a 350-million-parameter decoder-only transformer language model built by facebook and released on May 3rd, 2022. It operates as a text generation model using causal language modeling and accepts context windows of 2,048 consecutive tokens. The model was trained on 180 billion tokens (800GB) of data drawn from BookCorpus, CommonCrawl, The Pile, Reddit, and news sources ...
